title: The reorder write path refuses a move that contradicts a dependency
goal: A reorder that would put a step before its prerequisite is refused, with the reason, by the same path F-025 built
acceptance: F-025-T03's tool rejects an ordered list in which an item crosses one it depends on or that depends on it, with the message "X depends on Y" the card can show; the existing rejections (unknown, duplicate, stale base) are unchanged
Tests on the fake GitHub client, committed failing first: a move across a dependency refused, a move between independent items accepted, the PR still opened only for the accepted one and never merged
docs/decisions/solution-order-reorder.md's guard rails list the new rejection
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One more rejection in F-025-T03's validated rewrite, reading the payload's mustFollow and mustPrecede; no second write path. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
